title: Fatal Frame: Maiden of Black Water
synopsis: Koei Tecmo’s camera-obscura horror on Mt. Hikami, remastered — retained as the Asian Nintendo Switch edition with English cover.

catalog.release: 2014 (Wii U, Japan) · 2021 (remaster, October 28 · Asian physical, November)
catalog.region: Region-free · Asian edition, English via update · HAC-P-A437A
catalog.mediumForm: Nintendo Switch game card · Asian retail edition

custody.physical: Nintendo Switch game card in retail case

curatorNotes:
Fatal Frame: Maiden of Black Water is set on Mt. Hikami, a mountain of water rites and suicides, where three protagonists — Yuri Kozukata, Ren Hojo, and Miu Hinasaki — confront its ghosts with the Camera Obscura. It first released on Wii U in Japan in September 2014.

The remaster released digitally worldwide on October 28, 2021. Physical copies were issued only in Japan and Asia; this copy is the Asian edition with an English cover.

This filing opens the Fatal Frame lineage on the shelf.
collectionNotes:
The retained object is the Asian retail edition of Fatal Frame: Maiden of Black Water on a Nintendo Switch game card, with an English cover.

Dedicated artifact views of the individual copy have not yet been filed; the gallery below is held open for that documentation.

preservation.playableOn: Nintendo Switch; compatible Nintendo Switch family hardware
preservation.compatibility: Nintendo Switch software is region-free. The retained game card is the primary access copy and runs on any Nintendo Switch console.
preservation.concerns: Game cards are flash media; long-term charge retention, contact wear, and loss of the small card from its case are the principal risks. English voices and subtitles were added by an update released November 30, 2021; the card as issued is not playable in English without that update, which depends on Nintendo’s servers.
preservation.knownRevisions: Wii U release in Japan on September 27, 2014; the West in October 2015. The remaster released digitally worldwide on October 28, 2021; the Asian physical edition followed in November 2021, with English delivered by update.
preservation.availability: Physically distributed in Japan and Asia only; elsewhere the remaster was issued digitally.
